philosophy: Reject generic, floaty Material Design. Adopt 'Neo-Material': physical surfaces defined by crisp 1px borders, subtle ambient shadows, and extreme data clarity. Neutral baseline with highly intentional status colors.

headings.rules: Used for App Bar, Dialog Titles, Page Titles. Use tracking-tight for all headings > text-2xl. Use font-semibold or font-bold to create hierarchy without massive scaling. Max size text-4xl.

body.rules: Highly legible for data-heavy tables, timelines, chips, and inputs. Use leading-relaxed for WYSIWYG task descriptions.

colors.background: bg-zinc-50 (Neutral, very light gray) for the main application canvas to create subtle contrast with white cards.
colors.primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white for primary CTAs and active states. Absolute precision and authority.
colors.surface: bg-white for Cards, Dialogs, Drawers. Must use crisp 1px borders (border-zinc-200).

accents.overdue: Terracotta/Red (bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200) for Počítačově po termínu.
accents.today_active: Cobalt/Blue (bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200) for Dnes / Moje úkoly.
accents.tags: Use muted pastel backgrounds with dark text for high contrast (e.g., bg-amber-50 text-amber-800).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactile Polish' for Cards - flat white backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border). On hover, add a slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and a soft ambient shadow (shadow-md).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For the sticky App Bar, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a 1px bottom border (border-zinc-200/50). DO NOT use completely transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md) with interaction animations (active:scale-95). Primary is solid dark, secondary is outline or ghost.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Never show blank screens in the Dashboard. Use subtle dotted borders, gray text, and a clear 'Create Task' CTA.
visual_enhancers.progress_indicators: Use thin, elegant linear progress bars. No chunky spinners.

layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B). Dense data presentation. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Top row: KPI cards (col-span-1). Middle row: Wide charts or task lists (col-span-2 or 3).
layouts.navigation: Navigation Drawer (Left Sidebar) + Sticky App Bar. Sidebar should be collapsible (icon-only mode) on desktop to save space.
layouts.task_list: Data Tables with inline actions on hover. Rows should have a subtle hover state (hover:bg-zinc-50).
layouts.timeline: Chronological horizontal scrolling view. Use colored pills/bars with rounded-md to denote duration. Sticky left column for task names.
layouts.task_detail: Slide-over panel (Sheet) or massive Dialog. Two-column layout: left for TipTap WYSIWYG description/history, right for metadata (status, assignees, dates, chips).

component_guidelines.App Bar: Sticky top (z-40), glassmorphic, containing global search autocomplete, notifications, and profile avatar.
component_guidelines.Navigation Drawer: Fixed left sidebar (z-30). Contains links: Dashboard, Tasks, Timeline, Admin. Use subtle gray backgrounds for the active item.
component_guidelines.Cards: Flat white background, 1px border. No native Material drop shadows by default. Use for KPI metrics and task bento boxes.
component_guidelines.Chips: Used for tags and statuses. Must have a soft background (e.g., bg-blue-50) and readable text (text-blue-700).
component_guidelines.Dialogs: Use for Task Quick Add and Admin forms. Must have backdrop-blur on the overlay to focus user attention.
component_guidelines.Tabs: Underline style (not pill). The active tab gets a dark 2px bottom border, inactive tabs are gray-500.
component_guidelines.Data Tables: Dense layout, left-aligned columns, hover effects on rows. Include checkboxes for multi-select operations.
component_guidelines.WYSIWYG (TipTap): Clean formatting toolbar, subtle border, rich text support. Placed inside the Task Detail.
component_guidelines.Date Picker & Autocomplete: Use Shadcn popover and command components. Avoid ugly native browser inputs.
component_guidelines.Avatars: Rounded-full, 32px or 40px diameter. Use ring-2 ring-white for overlapping avatars in a group (Multi-select collaborators).

motion.hover: Subtle transform (-translate-y-0.5) on cards, background color shifts on rows/buttons.
motion.drawer: Smooth width transition (w-64 to w-16) for collapse/expand.
motion.dialogs: Scale up slightly (from 95% to 100%) and fade in using Framer Motion or Tailwind animate-in.
motion.rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not use generic 'transition: all' globally.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-900 focus-visible:ring-offset-2. Never remove focus outlines.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').

avatars.description: Female team member avatar in gray scarf

auth_background.description: Minimalistic composition featuring geometric shapes on black and beige split background. Use this for the image half of the Login/Register split screen.

icons.rules: Use clean, outlined icons. 20px size for standard buttons, 16px for dense tables/chips.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI for standard interactions (Select, Dialog, Tabs, Table) but customize them heavily with Tailwind to match the Swiss High-Contrast aesthetic.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the Bento Grid Dashboard layouts to ensure exact spacing.
Implement the Navigation Drawer as a collapsible aside. Ensure it behaves as a slide-over Drawer on mobile devices.
Use TipTap for the WYSIWYG task description editor.
Never use generic placeholder text; use contextual task data (e.g., 'Q3 Marketing Plan' instead of 'Task 1').
For the Timeline, use CSS grids with horizontal scrolling. Color-code tasks based on their status.
The codebase uses .js files, not .tsx. Implement React components with standard JSX (.js) syntax.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align most content for data legibility.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, button presses, etc.
Use generous padding inside cards (p-5 or p-6) but keep grid gaps tight (gap-4) for dashboard density.
